newsitem.title: SOMALIA: Three killed, seven wounded in south Mogadishu.
newsitem.headline: Three killed, seven wounded in south Mogadishu.

text.p: Three people were killed and seven wounded in a gun battle late on Monday between militiamen in south Mogadishu over taxes levied by Somali faction leader Hussein Aideed.

Witnesses said the three were killed and seven were wounded at a crossing point into south Mogadishu from the north on the Green Line battle zone dividing the capital after a dispute about taxes demanded on four truck-loads of various imported commodities.
Hussein Aideed, a 34-year-old former U.S. marine, took over as the main faction chief in war-shattered south Mogadishu when his 62-year-old father Mohamed Farah Aideed died on August 1.
